# @uhop/vault-storage-mcp

> Thin MCP (Model Context Protocol) adapter for vault-storage — an
> AI-agent-first personal knowledge base (markdown source of truth + SQLite +
> sqlite-vec index). Exposes the REST API as 61 MCP tools and 3 read-only
> resources for Claude Code and any other MCP client. Holds no vault state:
> every call forwards to a running vault-storage server identified by
> `VAULT_API_URL`, authenticated with the `VAULT_API_TOKEN` bearer token.

Plain JavaScript (ES modules), Node ≥ 26, stdio transport only.

## Docs

- [README.md](https://github.com/uhop/vault-storage/blob/main/mcp/README.md): install, configuration, tool groups, error codes
- [llms-full.txt](https://github.com/uhop/vault-storage/blob/main/mcp/llms-full.txt): full tool inventory and the response-shape contract
- [vault-storage](https://github.com/uhop/vault-storage): the server this adapter fronts (REST surface, data model, deployment)

## Key facts

- Run via `npx -y @uhop/vault-storage-mcp@latest`; env: `VAULT_API_URL`, `VAULT_API_TOKEN`.
- Tool groups: search & list (incl. `vault_context_pack` — one byte-budgeted
  RAG pack: hybrid top-K chunks + a deduped 1-hop graph whose inbound
  entries are the backlinks), read,
  narrow writes (`vault_append` / `vault_replace` / `vault_patch_fm` —
  asserted, atomic, small blast radius), whole-document writes (optional
  `expected_etag` sent as `If-Match`), lifecycle (`vault_supersede` /
  `vault_move` / `vault_propose`), maintenance, tags, graph insight, the
  suggestions review queue (claim / resolve batches), queue-item slices,
  repo leases (`vault_lease_*` — agent coordination: atomic claim / renew /
  release / transfer with a human-first precedence lattice), handoffs
  (`vault_handoff_*` — role-addressed cross-agent work requests: idempotent
  create, claim, the review-loop resolve with `returned` rework, resubmit,
  notes; durable in the server-side spool, archived into vault-data on
  resolution), and
  system reads (`vault_status`, `vault_lint`, `vault_resume_bundle`).
- Every tool description names the response shape it returns, including which
  of the three list shapes it uses: the paginated `{items, offset, limit,
  total}` envelope (page by `items.length`; the server caps `limit` at 100),
  the flat `{count, items}` queue slices, or a genuinely unpaginated read.
- Server errors surface as MCP tool errors with `{error, code, status, details}`.
